legend: High-power view showing epithelial cells arranged in a ductuloalveolar network lined by hobnail-shaped cells containing granular or vacuolated clear cytoplasm.
Low magnification shows a circumscribed nodule composed of closely packed and dilated tubules.

At higher magnification, the tubules are lined by single-layered cuboidal epithelial cells with vacuolated cytoplasm and occasional hobnail nuclei, with myoepithelial attenuation. Some dilated tubules contain luminal pink flocculent secretions.

Lactating adenoma shows circumscribed borders with packed tubules, many of which are dilated, lined by cuboidal epithelial cells with vacuolated bubbly cytoplasm, featuring occasional hobnail nuclei.  While many of the dilated tubules appear empty, there are several that contain flocculent pink secretions.
